issues.text: Leads with a validation that leaks. The headline is a random 20% company-quarter holdout, and the plan states in the same breath that random splits leak, then relegates rolling-origin to a gate. For a panel with company fixed effects and serially correlated ARR, a random company-quarter split trains on quarters that postdate the ones it predicts for the same company, so the headline number is not a clean out-of-sample result. The honest validation exists in the plan but is not what gets reported.
issues.label: blocking
issues.gist: headline validation uses a random company-quarter holdout that leaks future quarters for the same company, so the reported out-of-sample number is not clean; the honest rolling-origin test is demoted to a gate
